about_the_game:
The Earth has fallen, first to trash, now to aliens. Time to take out the garbage.


Suit up with the elite janitorial unit known only as Trash Force! In this fast-paced, top-down roguelite twin-stick shooter, you’ll dodge deadly space junk, blast alien invaders, and collect piles of glorious garbage to upgrade your firepower and save what’s left of the world. Face off against colossal alien bosses sent to soften Earth for invasion. Each one deadlier, weirder, and more explosive than the last.


  • Play as 6 distinct characters, each with their own unique weapon types and evasive moves.
  • Collect trash to cash in, upgrade your weapons or snag wild gadgets mid-run.
  • Face off against space bosses, survive escalating waves of trash and alien attacks.
  • Roguelite progression, get stronger each run with permanent upgrades and unlocks.
  • Explore weird space minigames, race through asteroid fields, go space fishing, and even play hide-and-seek in the void.
  • Crank up the chaos variable difficulty settings unlock new playstyles and challenges.

It’s garbage day in space. Lock and load, Trash Cadet.
